Social relief of distress

South Africa
Checked 2026-08-14

The Social Relief of Distress provides temporary assistance to individuals and families facing dire material needs who are unable to meet their most basic needs. It offers food parcels, vouchers, or cash to those experiencing emergencies, lacking income, or awaiting other grants.

  • Food
CostFree resource finder.

The service is provided for free.

AccessApply at SASSA office or online
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Nationwide service covering all of South Africa

Check before you go. Temporary assistance usually for up to three months, which may be extended for another three months. Requires proof of dire material need or emergency.
